Damru Bajaya | Hansraj Raghuwanshi | Mahashivratri Special
Maha shivratri ke shubh avsar par, baba hansraj raghuvanshi ne apne fains ke pyar ko dekhte hue "damru bajaya" git ko 24 ghante se bhi kam samay men taiyar kiya!
Aap sabhi apna aashirvad aur pyar aise hi banae rakhen.
Jay shankar maharaj
